Share cuts horizontally; mouldboard lifts and inverts the slice; landside presses on the furrow wall and keeps the plough straight.

front: Adjusting depth of an ox plough
back: Raise the wheel (deeper) or lower it (shallower); move the hitch up the vertical hake for deeper, down for shallower.
Move the hitch point along the horizontal row of holes on the hake.

front: When is a disc plough preferred?
back: Hard, stony, root-filled or sticky soils: the discs roll over obstacles.
